title: Algebra 2: Exponentials & Logarithms
tagline: Meet the exponential's inverse: evaluate logs by asking the right question, wield the three properties, crack equations no base-matching can touch, and model continuous growth with e.

chapters.title: The Logarithm: Exponents in Reverse
chapters.description: Define log_b as the exponent-finder, evaluate logs of all shapes, and meet the mirrored graph with its vertical asymptote.

chapters.title: Properties of Logarithms
chapters.description: Product, quotient, and power properties — derived straight from exponent rules — plus expand/condense fluency and the illegal moves to avoid.

chapters.title: Change of Base & Exponential Equations
chapters.description: Unlock any base on a two-button calculator, take logs of both sides to crack unmatchable exponentials, and solve log equations with the domain as final judge.

chapters.title: The Natural Base e
chapters.description: Meet the limit of continuous compounding, its logarithm ln, and the inverse pair that solves equations built on either.

chapters.title: Models & Logarithmic Scales
chapters.description: Continuous growth and decay with A = Pe^(rt), half-life clocks, and the log scales that measure earthquakes, acidity, and loudness.
